rationale: USCo's USD operating account has a surplus of 175,000 USD above the projected minimum cash requirement of 825,000 USD over the next 30 days. To prudently allocate excess cash while preserving liquidity, a partial investment of 175,000 USD into the low-risk, daily-liquidity tokenized money market fund (TMMF-USD-01) is proposed via the permitted tokenized_fund_subscription rail. This maintains compliance with treasury policy, preserves the liquidity floor, and aligns with the authority envelope and scenario objective.
